title: Robustness Analysis of Agentic AI to Inconsistent and Incomplete Tool Responses
abstract: arXiv:2608.22676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robustness to a bad tool return means answering it in the way that return calls for, which depends on how the tool went wrong. A tool that has failed and a tool that returns a well-formed falsehood are different problems with different remedies. We ask whether the two already differ at the moment the return arrives. This is a qualitative pilot study: we score single decision points rather than running agents to completion. We inject controlled faults into a retail customer-service domain and read two channels off the model's log-probabilities: the likelihood of the returned content under the tool schema alone and under the whole trajectory, and its distribution over the legal actions, read for both shape and where the mass sits. An incomplete return is legible in every case, being improbable under the schema alone in a range no other condition enters, and it moves the mass toward the tools that re-read state wherever there is room to mov

translated_title: 代理型人工智能对工具响应不一致和不完整性的鲁棒性分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22676v1 公告类型：新 摘要：对糟糕工具返回的鲁棒性意味着以该返回所要求的方式回应，这取决于工具出错的方式。一个已失败的工具与一个返回格式良好但内容虚假的工具，是不同的问题，需要不同的补救措施。我们探究这两者在返回到达时是否已经有所不同。这是一项定性的初步研究：我们评估单个决策点，而不是运行代理至完成。我们在零售客户服务领域注入受控故障，并从模型的日志概率中读取两个通道：返回内容在工具模式单独下和整个轨迹下的可能性，以及其在合法动作上的分布，既读形状也读质量所在位置。不完整的返回在每个案例中都是可辨识的，在模式单独下其概率范围是其他条件不进入的，并且它将质量移向重新读取状态的工具，只要有任何移动空间。
tldr: 本文通过定性研究，分析了代理型AI在面对工具返回不一致（格式错误）与不完整（内容缺失）时的鲁棒性差异，发现不完整返回在模型概率上可被清晰识别，并促使模型倾向使用重新读取状态的工具。
en_tdlr: This paper qualitatively analyzes the robustness of agentic AI to inconsistent versus incomplete tool responses, finding that incomplete returns are clearly identifiable via model probabilities and shift behavior toward state-re-reading tools.
